description: An unmarked callee inferred throwing is reported at the marked caller's call to it, and nowhere inside it: unmarked functions are allowed to throw.

diagnostics.message: Call to `parse` escapes this `@nothrow` function: its body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or make `parse` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
